purpose: Clinical research for hypertension service planning. We would prefer individual-level records for convenience; our deliverable is a single cohort count and we provide no methodological need for linked records.
question: Could we get individual diagnosis histories and systolic readings for the adult hypertension cohort? We prefer to make the spreadsheet ourselves, although our deliverable only needs the cohort headcount.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Cohort: adults aged at least 18 with a conditions.icd10 code beginning I10 and at least one systolic blood pressure observation (LOINC 8480-6).
Requested tables: conditions and observations, restricting observations to LOINC 8480-6; retain pseudonymous patient linkage only.
If aggregate access suffices, report the single metric cohort_size.
